subject: 🔍 Maintenance Request #$request_id - Further Investigation Required
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you for your patience regarding your maintenance request. After our initial assessment, we need to conduct further investigation before we can proceed with the repair.

=== REQUEST DETAILS ===
Request ID: $request_id
Issue Type: $issue_type
Priority: $priority
Submitted By: $created_by
Submission Date: $created_date
Location: $location

=== ORIGINAL ISSUE ===
$description

=== INVESTIGATION STATUS ===
Reviewed By: $reviewed_by
Review Date: $review_date
Current Status: Under Investigation

=== WHY FURTHER INVESTIGATION IS NEEDED ===
$investigation_reason

=== WHAT THIS MEANS ===

We have determined that this issue requires additional assessment before we can provide an accurate repair timeline or solution. This is necessary to:

1. IDENTIFY ROOT CAUSE
   $root_cause_details

2. DETERMINE SCOPE OF WORK
   $scope_details

3. ASSESS RESOURCE REQUIREMENTS
   $resource_requirements

=== NEXT STEPS ===

1. DETAILED INSPECTION
   When: $inspection_date
   Who: $inspector_name
   What: $inspection_scope
   
   We may need to:
   - Access additional areas for inspection
   - Perform diagnostic testing
   - Consult with specialized technicians
   - Obtain vendor quotes for parts/materials

2. SPECIALIST CONSULTATION
   $specialist_info

3. PARTS/MATERIALS ASSESSMENT
   $parts_assessment

=== ESTIMATED INVESTIGATION TIMELINE ===
Investigation Start: $investigation_start
Expected Duration: $investigation_duration
Target Completion Assessment: $assessment_target

Once our investigation is complete, we will:
- Provide a detailed repair plan
- Give you an accurate timeline
- Inform you of any costs (if applicable)
- Schedule the actual repair work

=== ACCESS REQUIREMENTS ===
We may need access to your unit/room for inspection:

Scheduled Inspection: $inspection_appointment
Estimated Duration: $inspection_time
Special Requirements: $special_requirements

$access_instructions

=== YOUR COOPERATION NEEDED ===

To help us complete this investigation efficiently, please:

✓ $action_item_1
✓ $action_item_2
✓ $action_item_3
✓ Be available during scheduled inspection times
✓ Provide any additional information if requested
✓ Keep the affected area accessible

=== TEMPORARY MEASURES ===
$temporary_measures

=== PRIORITY UPDATES ===
$priority_update

=== WILL THIS COST ANYTHING? ===
$cost_information

=== QUESTIONS OR CONCERNS? ===

If you have any questions about this investigation or need to discuss the timeline:

Contact Person: $contact_person
Email: $contact_email
Phone: $contact_phone
Reference ID: $request_id

Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Emergency: (555) 911-1234 (24/7)

=== STAY INFORMED ===

You will receive email updates when:
- ✉️ Investigation findings are available
- ✉️ A repair plan is developed
- ✉️ Work is scheduled
- ✉️ The repair is completed

You can also check the status anytime:
- Housing Portal: housing.university.edu
- Request ID: $request_id

=== ALTERNATIVE ARRANGEMENTS ===
$alternative_arrangements

=== ADDITIONAL NOTES ===
$additional_notes

=== WE APPRECIATE YOUR PATIENCE ===

We understand that waiting for repairs can be frustrating, and we appreciate your patience while we thoroughly investigate this issue. Our goal is to provide a permanent, effective solution rather than a temporary fix.

By taking the time to properly assess the situation, we can:
- Ensure the repair is done right the first time
- Prevent recurrence of the problem
- Identify any related issues
- Provide accurate timelines and expectations

If this issue is causing significant inconvenience or if your circumstances change, please contact us immediately so we can discuss possible interim solutions.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Best regards,
$reviewed_by
University Housing Maintenance Team
Email: maintenance@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567

---
